subject.title: feat: bind signed ClawHub default feed trust

question: Should this draft wait for the production signer, rotation fix, corrected RFC, and real public-key handoff before the default ClawHub trust policy is approved?
rationale: The code defines the permanent marketplace content trust root, fail-closed behavior, expiry authority, and key-rotation boundary; automation cannot approve that deployment sequence or trust ownership without maintainer intent.

options.title: Complete trust chain first
options.body: Keep this draft open until the producer and rotation PRs are ready, the RFC is settled, the real public key is bundled, and integrated proof is attached.

options.title: Land consumer scaffolding first
options.body: Merge the consumer-side identity and expiry contract before production activation, accepting that the default remains unsigned until a later key handoff.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Split identity and generic expiry hardening from the default ClawHub production trust-root activation for separate review and rollout.

recommendation.title: Complete trust chain first
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open until the producer and rotation PRs are ready, the RFC is settled, the real public key is bundled, and integrated proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest recent reviewer and repair contributor spanning both the OpenClaw consumer trust stack and the paired ClawHub signer contract.
